stem:
Uma dissolves a large amount of sugar in a small amount of water to make thick syrup.

Which claim names the solute and the solvent correctly?

options.text: Sugar is the solute and water is the solvent.
Sugar is the solvent and water is the solute.
Water stops being the solvent once more sugar than water is present.
Sugar is the solute only while undissolved sugar can still be seen.

teacher.key_rationale: In a sugar-in-water solution, sugar is the solute and water is the solvent, even when more sugar than water is dissolved and grains are no longer visible.
